free_text_constraints: Auto-mode intake: surface the full option space - standard of care, off-label rational combinations, clinical trials, and compassionate-use pathways. No modality vetoes and no hard toxicity vetoes beyond standard clinical reasonableness. Treat the planned cytoreductive-surgery-plus-HIPEC window as a sequencing constraint (systemic-therapy options should be evaluated for how they sequence with or pause around peri-operative HIPEC). Sex not specified at intake - downstream agents should flag if their recommendation depends on sex-specific dosing or contraindications. Primary tumor resection status not specified - flag as a gap. ECOG 1 is an assumption from current FOLFIRI tolerance and should be confirmed.
